source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1939: nominations closed 25 April 1939 and, after Gibson withdrew in Kernan, "all other candidates nominated are returned unopposed"; no poll. "The other retiring members, who include Mr. J. H. Walsh, will probably be co-opted to the Council." The Belfast News-Letter (26 April 1939, p. 3) and Portadown News (29 April 1939, p. 2) say the nine divisions other than Kernan had no nominations other than retiring members. Returned unopposed.
